sources.title: Equations with identities — adapted lesson
sources.attribution: David Lippman and Melonie Rasmussen, Precalculus: An Investigation of Functions. Lesson adapted from Section 7.1. Worked seed: Example 4, printed pp.457-458 / PDF pp.5-6, tan(x)=3sin(x), 0<=x<2pi. Change coefficient 3 to 1 and rename x to theta; add explicit overlapping-branch and original-domain proof.

Changes: Rename t to theta; retain equation and interval; solve in cosine via nonzero-denominator clearing instead of the source secant substitution.
